execution.ref: VALIDATOR-13 slice 1, branch claude/validator-13-hidden-pool. Canonical: hidden-score, Graphite experiment, battery adapter and rule-v2 suites passed; the canonical results are recorded in the PR.
execution.description: Graphite constructions are now also scored on the battery validator's hidden pool through deployment.evaluate under rule v2, with the agent seeing only the sealed miner outcome.

expected: Graphite's evidence could come from hidden batches without the agent being able to tell how it scored on them.
observed: It can. A non-leak differential test runs one construction against two different hidden pools: the operator aggregates differ, and the agent's feedback is byte-identical. Rule v1 discloses hidden screening scores to miners, so the hidden pool refuses any rule that is not sealed.
keep: Prove non-disclosure with a differential: vary only the hidden material and require the agent-visible bytes to be identical.
Score development evidence through the validator's own evaluation path, never a copy.
change: Practice-case scores are adaptive development feedback; never rank or report them as exam evidence.
protocol_elements: every Challenge's development evidence is scored on hidden batches through its real validator, with miner-equivalent disclosure
